note: Eleven rows, and eleven is the whole of it: [A8 §9 item 8] records that every other fact class is uncovered. The subject family column is quoted from [SD §4.7], never re-derived here ([A8 §5] caveat i). Every row's authority is boundBy = CUSTODY unless the row says otherwise ([A8 §5] caveat iii), but the value is written out on every row rather than inherited, because an inherited default is the thing that goes wrong silently.
owedNote: Owed is a value, never an absence. A standing names role-enum members in 'roles' and every asserter designation that is NOT an enum member in 'unresolved', each carrying what it is owed to — usually [A8 §9 item 2] (the role vocabulary is undefined), sometimes [A8 §9 item 1] (there is no party entity), and in row 9's case not owed at all but COMPUTED by custodyAt. An empty standing is written as an empty standing with a note saying so; it never arrives as a missing key.
structuralObservation: [A8 §5]'s own closing paragraph: three of eleven rows have no authoritative role — weight.net and sitEntryDate are empty, condition is plural rather than empty. 'That is not a failure of the table. In each case a source supplies something BETTER than a role — a value rule, a mandatory derivation, or a joint record — and the table's job is to say so rather than to invent a winner.' [ORIGINAL] as an observation. Those are exactly the three rows carrying a 'settlement', which is [A8 §4.4] A8-NAMED holding: where authoritative is empty or plural, a tie-break rule MUST be named and 'a resolution may never fall back to latest wins implicitly'.
overlapNote: A role may appear in two standings on one row: [A8 §5 r1] has destinationAgent corroborating at its own end AND competing at destination. The loader does not forbid the overlap, because the document requires it.

authoritative.note: Not a fixed list: 'the role holding custody at that stop'. driver where the stop is on our trip, hauler where the trip is the hauling agent's. Which one applies is computed by custodyAt(goods, instant) at the instant the fact is ABOUT ([A8 §4.2] A8-INSTANT), never by recency.

corroborating.note: originAgent/destinationAgent at their own end. Absence of corroboration is NOT evidence ([A8 §4.1] note 1) — most of these roles have no obligation to speak.

competing.note: At destination. The deliberate entry: the critique's own example is the destination agent's shipment-level claim against the driver's stop-level claim; both are real, and E-CANON is what makes them pair ([SD §4.6.3]).

settlement.note: What is authored is letting FactResolved.selected be EMPTY. 'If a consumer proves it cannot tolerate an unresolved fact, the fix is a DOWNSTREAM named rule, never selecting inside the resolution — selecting there would destroy the one thing every source in this row preserves.' A8-JOINT also reaches 'the counts asserted with it', which is what makes pieceCount's boundary case covered.

rows.evidence: The best-sourced row in the document. src:dp3-400ng Item 17.12.c — BOTH TSP and warehouseman must hold 'the condition of EACH ARTICLE when received at and forwarded from the storage location'; src:cfr-49-375 §375.503 — itemized inventory signed by both; src:dp3-tender-of-service NTS §1.6.2 (condition by omission) and §C.9.a(22) (describing cartons as 'misc.' waives the right to contest).

authoritative.note: Authority NEVER MOVES. This is the one row where boundBy is not custody and not the principal: it is the naming scheme, and the scheme does not change hands. Note that an issuer's RESPONSIBILITY can be reassigned with an effective date (src:dp3-400ng GBLOC, Regionalization p.17), which is why [SD §7.2]'s interval carries it rather than a static field.

Under one scheme there is one issuer, so there is nothing to contest: SIRVA's Brand+RegNumber+RegYear and Weichert's serviceOrderNumber are PEER references, neither authoritative over the other, because they are values under two different schemes ([SD §7.1] I-KEY keys the fact on the full triple).

rows.evidence: SOURCED, and the shared layer already carries the field: [SD §7.1]'s issuer and scheme. src:dcsa supplies the pattern outright — a party is carrierCode + carrierCodeListProvider, i.e. code plus the authority that issued it. src:dtr-part-iv supplies the counter-case that proves the rule has teeth: the BL number is serially pre-assigned accountable stock, audited every 180 days.

standings.note: CORRECTED BY [SD §4.7.2b]. A8 named three authorities over 'one fact class'; under the derived key (subject, type, qualifier?) that would put a proposal, an approval and a price into ONE contest, where an approval would compete with an amount. The {aspect} qualifier makes them THREE FACT KEYS, each with the authority this row already assigns. The three-way split is the finding and does not otherwise change.

unresolved.owedTo: Not fixed — it is whichever role performed the act the charge is for, so it varies by charge. [A8 §9 item 2] owes the enum it would be drawn from.

rows.evidence: SOURCED three ways. WHO asserted each number: src:milmove-mymove tags every priced input with PaymentServiceItemParam.origin ∈ PRIME | SYSTEM | PRICER | PAYMENT_REQUEST, and nothing is billable unless a matching service item was created AND APPROVED. The propose/decide split: src:dtr-part-iv models accessorial pre-approval as a typed record (Pending → Approved/Denied, 3-GBD PPSO SLA, §C.8, §D.6); src:milmove-mymove carries both narratives attributed (contractorRemarks on the request, officeRemarks on the decision). Rating is the tariff owner's: src:sirva-ade, GSD p.3.
